verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own DuckLake capability lets you build a lakehouse on your own files in your own cloud object storage, which supports keeping data portable. It is also built on DuckDB, with local DuckDB access via the CLI and SDKs and queries routed across local and cloud. However, no evidence documents an explicit export path, such as copying databases out to Parquet/CSV or downloading a MotherDuck database as a file. missing for 10: documented bulk export of all data to open formats, explicit Parquet/open-format guarantees for stored data, offboarding or account-exit guidance, independent corroboration of a successful migration off MotherDuck.
